name: [CHECKPOINTS] Slap Tower 7🖐️
desc:
🧱 Slap Tower Obby 🖐️
Climb, jump, and slap your way to the top!
Race to the top of a chaotic obby tower filled with tricky jumps, sneaky shortcuts, and other players trying to slap you off. Hit checkpoints to save progress, outplay your opponents, and be the last one standing at the summit!

JOIN GROUP HERE FOR PERKS: https://www.roblox.com/communities/35933102/Waffle-Beast-Studios#!/about

💥 Slap others off the tower
✅ Reach checkpoints to save your progress
🏆 Compete to reach the top first
😈 Push, troll, and dodge incoming slaps
🎮 Can you handle the chaos?
